name: Taiga Arsenal
author: IornMan1213
description: 50 Soviet and Russian munitions modelled at their real sizes, with the real weapons' mass, warheads, motors and seekers: GSh-30-1 cannon rounds, R-27 / R-74M / R-77 missiles, Kh-25 / Kh-29 / Kh-31 / Kh-38 / Kh-59 air-to-surface missiles, KAB, FAB and RBK bombs, rocket pods and a jamming pod. Offered on the MiG-29 Fulcrum, MiG-29SMT and Su-30VXN Gandiva mods when they are installed.
